cumleler: Which ear does a bone vibrator actually test?
The bone vibrator vibrates the whole skull.
The vibration reaches both cochleae almost equally.
So interaural attenuation is about zero decibels.
The unmasked bone threshold reflects the better of the two cochleae.
To find which ear responds, the opposite ear is masked.
